notes.title: Post-Release Plans
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

It’s been a crazy couple of days for us! A huge thanks to everyone who has been giving us feedback on the [url=https://discord.gg/Ffuw8Y6qde] Cosmic Spud discord [/url] and in the forums here. We have gotten quite a few questions about future plans, so I wanted to give a quick update on the major items we are working on right now. 

[h3][u][b]Future Updates[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]As soon as possible:[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements and better steam integration.
[*] Rework the How to Play section to be easier to understand/have less text (For now, check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2746616478] this [/url] guide if you are struggling)
[*] Balance pass based on community feedback and our own observations.
[/list]
[b]If Feasible:[/b]
[list]
[*] Linux Build. The main hurdle here is testing. If anyone is interested in helping out, head over to the Cosmic Spud discord and shoot me a message.
[/list]
[b]First Content Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Beastman Shaman enemy
[*] New mutations, particularly rares
[*] New Azul and rare items
[*] New props and secrets
[*] Additional prebuilt areas for existing stages
[/list]
We have plans for some bigger updates down the road, but I want to focus on finishing the ASAP section before I start detailing out too much. We should also have a minor patch out at the end of the week to address some minor bugs and mutation balance. This has been a fantastic experience so far, and I look forward to seeing more crazy builds and god runs!

- Cosmic Spud Garrett

notes.title: Upcoming Release Date
notes.notes:
After a lot of work over the past month, we think we're ready to finally announce when Ancient will be releasing...

[previewyoutube=BeBmik-sBns;full][/previewyoutube]

Ancient is set to release on February 4th, 2022! 

Thanks for the feedback we've gotten along the way and we hope to continue receiving more throughout the process of release. Wishlist the game now and steam will let you know when it is available for purchase. You can also expect to see a livestream from us on that day, catch us over on Twitch at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/cosmic_spud_official]Cosmic_Spud_Official[/url], details on stream time(s) to follow on our subreddit.


Follow us over on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CosmicSpud/]r/CosmicSpud[/url] for additional and more frequent updates.

This is our first major game release and we can't wait to get it into your hands,
